C0466.title: Photo-Editing Trickery: Man in Qinzhou Scams Pawnshops Three Times with Fake Transfer Screenshots
C0466.summary: Between February and May 2022, a man surnamed Lin in Qinzhou used photo-editing techniques to alter the amounts and times on transfer screenshots, deceiving pawnshops and other merchants into trusting the fake payment records, and succeeded in scamming them three times in a row. The court convicted Lin of fraud, sentencing him to one year and two months in prison plus a fine of 5,000 yuan, and ordered him to repay victims a total of 6,650 yuan.
